text:
Maria S.: heads-up — seeing a spike in late deltas for telemetry.aggregate_hours in eu-prod starting 2026-03-15. backlog ~120k keys, mostly low-volume shards. can someone take point for a targeted reprocess?
Trevor H.: taking it. do we know if it's fresh late arrivals or stuck replay jobs? :thinking_face:
Maria S.: looks like late arrivals from ingestion (kafka lag spikes) + a few failed recompute runs last week. replay-bot: queued 2 dependent jobs for 2075001200 window.
Jin K.: quick filter to prioritize — prefer non-zero-delta keys only. reduces work by ~70%. snippet: ```sql
SELECT shard_id FROM deltas WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15' AND delta != 0 GROUP BY shard_id
```
Katie (oncall): keep API SLOs in mind. if backfill uses dedicated workers, cap concurrency to 6 per region. keep latency alerts unmuted.
Trevor H.: plan: 1) run parity-check pass (dry) against current agg_hours 2) mark safe checkpoint 3) run bounded reprocess with concurrency=6, token-bucket pacing 4) monitor dashboard and stop on >0.5% error rate.
Ben L.: add a short-lived rollout flag so queries can read fallback aggregates if the recompute trips. also add a metric: telemetry.backfill.progress_pct and telemetry.backfill.error_rate.
Maria S.: created a temporary dashboard panel and linked it here: https://console.redwood/internals/dashboards/telemetry/backfill-eu-2075 :eyes:
Trevor H.: starting dry-run now — tailing logs. command: ```./tools/replay --window 2026-03-15T00:00Z/2026-03-16T00:00Z --shards $(shards.txt) --dry-run```
replay-bot: job 98765 started (dry-run)
Trevor H.: dry-run caught a transform NPE in step transform_v2 for shard 42. log excerpt: ```java.lang.NullPointerException at TransformV2.apply(TransformV2.java:88)```
Jin K.: I saw that before — caused by empty metadata for legacy events. quick patch: skip transform_v2 if metadata==null; pushing a hotfix to feature/replay-null-meta.
Maria S.: deploy hotfix to staging, then re-run dry-run. tagging @Katie for perf watch. :thumbsup:
Katie (oncall): staging looks good, no latency regressions. ready to promote.
Trevor H.: re-run dry-run after hotfix — no NPEs now. starting bounded run in 15m with monitoring hooks. pacing token bucket set to 2000 msgs/min per worker.
Ben L.: reminder — enable the fallback read route before we start heavy writes, TTL fallback 30m.
Maria S.: enabled fallback route and set a canary check. will roll back fallback on signal if anything weird. :ok_hand:
replay-bot: job 98766 started (bounded run)
Trevor H.: first 10% of shards completed, progress: 12%. error_rate=0.02% (within limit).
Jin K.: will follow up after run with a small script to reconcile counts: ```python
# quick check
local = read_agg(shard)
remote = compute_agg(shard)
assert local.count == remote.count
```
Maria S.: if we see >0.5% mismatch for any hour, we pause and investigate. logging any mismatches to #incidents for visibility.
Ben L.: once all shards finish, run a short integrity job to recompute affected downstream materializations (search indices / billing aggregations).
Trevor H.: finishing run now — final progress 100%, no major errors. kicking integrity job.
replay-bot: job 98766 finished SUCCESS in 00:42:13
Maria S.: great work — closing thread. will open a follow-up RFC for long-term mitigation: smarter ingress throttles + per-tenant replay quotas. thanks everyone. :party_panda:
